concerns.text: The plan substitutes the required “2025 CO₂ hydrogenation experimental TOF” dataset with the generic surrogate TOF collection `locuslab/TOFU` (Hugging Face). This surrogate does not contain CO₂ hydrogenation-specific turnover frequencies, violating FR‑001 which mandates experimental TOFs for the target reaction. Using a non‑matching TOF source undermines the core research question and prevents a valid assessment of descriptor performance for CO₂ hydrogenation catalysts.
